customize.name: Illuga
customize.desc: Member of the investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles. The youngest squad leader among the Lightkeepers.

customize.name: Flins
customize.desc: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.

customize.name: Nikita
customize.desc: The current Starshyna of the Lightkeepers.

customize.name: Alia
customize.desc: The second Reed Miller and the First Moonchanter's sister from the Frostmoon Scions. She lived 500 years ago.

customize.name: Silver Lampwick
customize.desc:
A sacred lamp capable of forming a protective barrier, now dimmed after its energy is depleted.
Once a ritual vessel of the Frostmoon Scions, it brought dreams and song to the lost people wandering the desolate lands. It has survived to this day only because it was left behind in the time-stilled tower.
